servicesPage.intro: From concept to completion, our carpentry services cover every need for your home or office. We specialize in custom furniture, cabinetry, millwork, and restoration.

services.title: Custom Furniture
services.shortDescription: Design and build unique tables, chairs, beds, and more.
services.longDescription: Our custom furniture service brings your ideas to life. We work with you to select wood species, finishes, and dimensions that complement your space. Every piece is handcrafted in our Dallas workshop.
benefits: Unique design tailored to your style
Wide range of wood and finish options

process.title: Consultation
process.description: We discuss your vision, take measurements, and offer design suggestions.

process.title: Design & Quotation
process.description: We provide detailed drawings and a transparent quote.

process.title: Build & Delivery
process.description: We craft your piece and deliver it with care.

faqs.question: How long does a custom furniture piece take?
faqs.answer: Typically 4-6 weeks from design approval, depending on complexity.

faqs.question: Do you use sustainable wood?
faqs.answer: Yes, we source from responsible suppliers and offer reclaimed options.

services.title: Cabinetry & Built-Ins
services.shortDescription: Custom kitchen, bathroom, and living room cabinetry.
services.longDescription: Transform your storage with custom cabinets that maximize space and style. We design and install kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, entertainment centers, and bookshelves that blend seamlessly with your home.

process.title: Site Assessment
process.description: We measure and evaluate the space for optimal design.

process.title: Custom Design
process.description: We create 3D renderings and select materials.

process.title: Fabrication & Installation
process.description: We build and install with minimal disruption.

faqs.question: Can you match existing cabinetry?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can match stains, paints, and styles to blend with your current cabinets.

faqs.question: Do you offer warranty on cabinets?
faqs.answer: All our cabinetry comes with a 5-year craftsmanship warranty.

services.title: Furniture Repair & Restoration
services.shortDescription: Restore antiques and repair damaged furniture.
services.longDescription: We breathe new life into your treasured pieces. Our restoration services include structural repairs, refinishing, reupholstery, and hardware replacement. We handle antiques with the utmost care.

process.title: Evaluation
process.description: We assess damage and provide a restoration plan.

process.title: Approval
process.description: We present the scope and cost for your approval.

process.title: Restoration
process.description: We carefully restore the piece to its former glory.

faqs.question: Can you repair water damage?
faqs.answer: Yes, we specialize in repairing water rings, warping, and finish damage.

faqs.question: How long does a typical restoration take?
faqs.answer: Most projects are completed within 2-3 weeks.

services.title: Custom Millwork & Trim
services.shortDescription: Baseboards, crown molding, wainscoting, and more.
services.longDescription: Add elegance and character with custom millwork. We design and install crown molding, baseboards, wainscoting, window casings, and custom paneling. Our precision ensures perfect miters and seamless joints.

process.title: Design Consultation
process.description: We help you choose profiles and layout.

process.title: Material Selection
process.description: We offer MDF, solid wood, and premium composites.

process.title: Installation
process.description: Our team installs with meticulous attention to detail.

faqs.question: Can you match existing trim?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can replicate existing profiles or create custom ones.

faqs.question: Do you paint the trim?
faqs.answer: We can install primed or pre-finished, and we also offer painting services.

about.headline: Crafting Excellence in Dallas Since 2005
about.mission: To provide Dallas homeowners and businesses with exceptional custom woodwork that combines beauty, function, and longevity.
story: Wood Furniture YP started as a small workshop with a passion for woodworking. Our founder, a master carpenter with over 20 years of experience, set out to create furniture that was both artistic and durable. Over the years, we've grown into a full-service carpentry studio serving clients across Dallas.

Today, we remain committed to the same principles: meticulous attention to detail, use of the finest materials, and a dedication to customer satisfaction. Every project, whether a tiny repair or a complete home renovation, receives the same level of care and expertise.
